label: Motion Studio
tagline: Cinematic full-bleed video + UI choreographed as linear scenes - Apple-product-page / motionsites register
description: Presentation-first sections/pages where the aesthetic payload is tightly choreographed full-bleed generated video (or motion raster) + UI - split into a LINEAR sequence of full-screen scenes the visitor steps through back and forth, with within-scene hold beats (video pauses on an authored frame, UI animates in, next input releases). Library-backed: reads docs/research/motion-scene-library.index.json (30 techniques across scroll-driven / pointer-driven / ambient / scene-choreography / composition - scroll-entrance, scroll-scrub rotation, mouse-tracked subjects, faux-3D parallax layers, quiet-zone composition). UNIQUE TRIGGER SHAPE: mode=brainstorm runs BEFORE any HTML exists - it claims which surfaces of the brief become motion scenes and returns exact ms-mount slot tags + the hygienic scope; the chat caller then scaffolds the shell and builds the non-motion remainder, and dispatches mode=build which enumerates ms-mount iframes, runs ms-research-technique per slot, scaffolds the multi-trio node graph (research/storyboard/concept-plates/scenes/motion/interactions/runtime/container) and returns a hand-off envelope. CONCEPT-PLATE GATE: per scene, a hi-res generated design plate of the full composed frame (asset + UI drawn together, real copy) is produced and visually inspected (concept.json: observed layout, palette, scrim, assetPromptNotes + uiBuildNotes), then surfaced to the user for approve/steer BEFORE any video budget is spent - the approved plate is the composition contract that asset generation (i2v reference where supported), UI build, and Step-8 QA all obey. Asset generation is hi-res (≥1920×1080) edge-to-edge with composition-aware prompts: subjectAnchor + quietZone + interactionClause go INTO the generation prompt so UI placement and input bindings agree with the delivered asset (subject right → UI left; mouse-scrub videos generated as one continuous motion axis). Video-first with an explicit degradation ladder: video → motion raster (raster-sequence / raster + CSS motion) → Hyperframes HTML animation LAST and genre-gated (research commits hyperframesEligible - vector-native registers only; immersive/photorealistic registers stop at raster + CSS, since vector animation breaks the spell there). Always-something-in-motion rule per scene; muted+playsinline only, no audio, no permission gates. §8.3 loop-until-bar; opt-in §8.7 multi-draft at storyboard (scene-split axis), concept (layout axis), motion (transition register) and runtime (pacing) cruxes; Step-8 QA adds frame-sampled text-over-motion contrast + composition-honoured + off-screen-pause checks; Phase F boundary pass covers the self vs host-scroll binding contracts.

triggers.title: Brainstorm BEFORE the shell - claims motion surfaces first
triggers.rule: When the brief implies a cinematic presentation register (Apple-product-page, motionsites-style hero, video-led brand page), chat dispatches motion-studio-orchestrator mode=brainstorm BEFORE writing any HTML. It returns sectionClaims (exact ms-mount slot tags) + hygienicScope; chat scaffolds the shell embedding the tags, builds the hygienic remainder normally, then dispatches mode=build once.

triggers.title: Build pass - enumerate ms-mount slots
triggers.rule: After the shell exists, ONE mode=build dispatch walks every source/<prototype>/*.html, finds every <iframe class~='ms-mount'> (or data-ms set), runs research per slot, scaffolds the per-slot drawer set, and returns the hand-off envelope; the workflow-mode chat drives the build phase (lens trios, multi-draft cruxes, container commit, Step-8 QA + Phase F).
